semiconductor_relevance: High — FST specializes in equipment and materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in pellicles and chillers.
summary: FST (Fine Semitech Corp.) provides advanced equipment and materials for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries, focusing on energy-saving chillers and pellicles for contamination control. The company has a strong commitment to innovation and quality, aiming to enhance manufacturing processes and customer satisfaction.
capabilities: Energy-saving chillers for temperature and humidity control
Fully automated EUV pellicle mounting and demounting systems
Optical inspection systems for semiconductor applications
